issues.on_page: Taxes: Other 24,933 (Statement of Activities p2: Homestead/other)
issues.issue: Printed under the Taxes heading and called Homestead/other on p2; 'other taxes' (or Homestead Exemption, if a person confirms) may fit better than plain other. Same for detail[1]. Category came from the user's 2026-10-23 decision for label 'Other', so left as a judgment call.

The same label 'Services' is charges for services/fees elsewhere (receipts[10] 4,315 includes this 110; detail[6], detail[11]). The department makes Cemetery Fees defensible, but the same label now has two categories.
Budget schedule p9 confirms Culture and recreation 141,803 = Library 56,060 + Community Improvement 73,243 + 12,500, so this is defensible. The label reads like economic development, though.

Re-read the digits: the gap is real. Total-column lines add to 656,854 receipts and 560,318 disbursements, while the printed totals 656,853 / 560,319 roll forward exactly to 1,030,233. The report also has other 1-dollar footing gaps (Street receipts column adds to 147,516 vs 147,515 printed; General disbursements column adds to 390,893 vs 390,892; CRA fund balance adds to 213,341 vs 213,342 printed; p3 Street assets 49,650 vs 49,651 printed). Correctly left as printed.

Re-read the digits: the gap is real. 381,117 = 390,892 - 9,775 (Care Center), yet the Total column's Other row 26,066 includes the 9,775. Operating income 103,212 = 484,329 - 381,117. Net gain 32,288 = 484,329 - 390,892 - 61,149. Correctly recorded.
